title: Potentiometer knob (IR v1)
prompt: Simple round knob for a potentiometer with a 6 mm round shaft: 30 mm diameter, 15 mm tall, a 6 mm hole 10 mm deep from the bottom for the shaft, and a 2 mm 45° chamfer around the top edge.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
The chamfer is around the top edge (the bore's end): the centroid sits at z = 7.448 (7.691 with the chamfer at the bottom)
Three flat faces: top, bottom ring and the flat bottom of the blind bore
Two cylindrical faces: the outside and the bore
One Ø6 bore (a hole feature or a circle)
The shaft bore opens in the bottom face (z = 0), where the shaft goes in

notes: IR v1 rewrite of t1-knob: extrude + chamfer + blind flat-bottom hole instead of one revolved profile.
